title: D-024 Amendment 3 unit E: bounded /goal integration (one cohesive assignment, safe completion condition, check-in ingestion)
objective: Integrate /goal as the inner continuation mechanism per D-024-R152/R174 and the M0-T102 matrix (goal-bounded-continuation, context-safeguards areas): generate a measurable completion condition from the task packet for ONE bounded Fable assignment (never one goal for the entire campaign); handle condition-met, impossible, no-progress (goal stays set), the four unrecoverable clearing classes, resume (counters reset), and context-pressure behavior; ingest background-work check-ins (>=2.1.234/2.1.236; idle cap 2.1.246) into the journal; no worker-visible token pressure in goal conditions or prompts (R045); /autocompact configured as EMERGENCY buffer only, never a seam substitute; live behavioral fixtures + a real low-risk canary on 2.1.246 (the goal contract is NOT available on 2.1.220). Health bands remain private controller evidence. Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R152 + D-024-R174.
business_reason: Amendment 3: /goal replaces a custom inner prompter as the per-assignment continuation primitive, wrapped by durable custom policy.
